portal_hypertension.title: Use of a recanalized umbilical vein to embolize bleeding varices: A case report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Sarhan A, Cucchiara J, Biswal R
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：本病例报告详细介绍了一名 60 多岁失代偿性肝硬化女性危及生命的胃静脉曲张出血的成功治疗。 临床提示：患者出现吐血和失血性休克。
portal_hypertension.abstract: This case report details the successful management of life-threatening gastric variceal bleeding in a female in her 60s with decompensated liver cirrhosis. The patient presented with hematemesis and hemorrhagic shock. After initial resuscitation, an esophagogastroduodenoscopy identified large gastric varices with signs of recent bleeding. A conventional transfemoral endovascular attempt to embolize the varix failed due to tortuous venous anatomy. Given the failure, an alternative approach was utilized by accessing a patent, recanalized umbilical vein. Under ultrasound guidance, this percutaneous transumbilical route provided direct access to the portal venous system. A catheter was successfu...

portal_hypertension.title: On the History of Hepatic Vein Catheterization.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Henriksen JH, Bendtsen F, Møller S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：80 年前，继右侧心导管插入术之后，首次对男性进行了肝静脉导管插入术 (HVC)。 临床提示：随后出现了几种新的方法、认识和概念，特别是用于测定内脏血流量的间接菲克法。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hepatic vein catheterization (HVC) in man was first performed 80 years ago in the wake of right-sided heart catheterization. Several new methods, recognitions and concepts followed, especially the indirect Fick-method for determination of splanchnic blood flow. Five years passed before pressure measurements were performed and routine HVCs were done in liver patients. Later came splanchnic kinetics of test substances, dyes, metabolites, hormones and bioactive material and counter current wedged and balloon occlusion pressure. HVC has been a prerequisite for our understanding of the pathogenesis of portal hypertension and variceal bleeding leading to serial measurements, stratification, quanti...

portal_hypertension.title: Refractory Esophageal Varices Requiring Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt Placement in Oxaliplatin-Induced Portosinusoidal Vascular Disorder.
portal_hypertension.authors: Vu J, Aggarwal A, Morshedi M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：我们报告了一个罕见的奥沙利铂相关 PSVD 病例，表现为食管静脉曲张难以套扎，最终需要经颈静脉肝内门体分流术放置静脉曲张栓塞。 临床提示：结直肠癌是美国癌症相关死亡的主要原因。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Colorectal carcinoma is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality in the United States. Capecitabine and oxaliplatin, a standard first-line chemotherapy regimen contains oxaliplatin, which rarely causes sinusoidal injury leading to portosinusoidal vascular disorder (PSVD). We report a rare case of oxaliplatin-associated PSVD presenting with esophageal varices refractory to banding, ultimately requiring transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt placement with variceal embolization. With few similar cases reported in the literature and in the absence of guidelines on managing refractory esophageal varices in PSVD, this case demonstrates a successful outcome with transjugular intrahepatic...

portal_hypertension.title: Beyond consensus: Identifying divergences in the care of children with portal hypertension.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of pediatric gastroenterology and nutrition
portal_hypertension.authors: Mercadal-Hally M, Ilhardt T, Ackermann O
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：正如欧洲儿科胃肠病学、肝病学和营养学会之前所报告的那样，门脉高压 (PHT) 对儿童构成了重大的临床挑战，不同医疗中心的管理方法差异很大。 临床提示：正如欧洲儿科胃病学会之前报告的那样，门脉高压 (PHT) 对儿童构成了重大的临床挑战，不同医疗中心的管理方法差异很大
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension (PHT) poses a significant clinical challenge in children, with management approaches varying widely across different medical centres, as previously reported by the European Society for Paediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition Portal Hypertension Special Interest Group (PHT-SIG). This brief communication reviews the results of a follow-up questionnaire-based study carried out by the PHT-SIG to explore further management issues not covered in the initial survey. While most clinicians concur on key definitions and regularly use oesophagogastroduodenoscopy for both primary and secondary prophylaxis, notable differences remain in the application of non-selective b...

portal_hypertension.title: AI-assisted ascites volumetry for prognostic stratification in HCC treated with Atezolizumab/Bevacizumab.
portal_hypertension.journal: Cancer imaging : the official publication of the International Cancer Imaging Society
portal_hypertension.authors: Moos M, Bender D, Foerster F
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 90）。核心观点：腹水一直与预后受损相关。 临床提示：已知门脉高压相关参数对肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患者具有重要的预后意义。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension-related parameters are known to have important prognostic implications in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Ascites has consistently been associated with impaired outcomes. However, the prognostic relevance of quantified ascites volume in patients undergoing Atezolizumab/Bevacizumab remains unclear. 90 patients with HCC treated with Atezolizumab/Bevacizumab between 2020 and 2024 were retrospectively included. Ascites was assessed on baseline contrast-enhanced CT imaging using AI-based pre-segmentation followed by manual correction to quantify ascites volume.
